glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_glass_body.desc: Raw power in a body that cracks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_predator_eyes.de: You see the prey — and the prey sees you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_predator_eyes.bo: Enemies within 20 blocks glow through walls; +25% damage to targets below 50% health
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_predator_eyes.pr: You glow too, and monsters within 16 blocks come for you
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_blind_fury.price: Cannot cast healing spells and receives only 50% of healing
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_bloodlust.desc: The form feeds on the fallen.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_bloodlust.boon: Each kill heals 5% of max health
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_bloodlust.price: Lose 1% of max health every 2 s (never below 1 heart)
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_unstable_form.bo: Melee hits release (1×/s) a burst of a random element around the target
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_unstable_form.pr: Each burst deals 1.5 recoil damage to you
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_iron_root.desc: You become a wall — and walls don't run.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_iron_root.boon: −35% damage taken and immune to knockback
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_silence_vow.desc: You swear not to cast — the body collects the rest.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_silence_vow.boon: +60% physical damage (melee and arrows) and −15% damage taken
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_silence_vow.pric: Cannot cast ANY spell while transformed
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_last_breath.desc: Staying a little longer costs dearly.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_last_breath.pric: When it ends, you are exhausted for 30 s (Slowness II, Weakness II, Mining Fatigue)
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_relentless_rhyth: Each consecutive hit grants +8% damage (up to +40%)
3 s without hitting breaks the rhythm: 0.5 damage per lost stack
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_mana_pact.price: Each cast costs 4% of max health
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_guardian_oath.de: You are the party's shield — and shields don't leave their post.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_guardian_oath.bo: Party allies (and your pets) within 8 blocks take −35% damage
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_guardian_oath.pr: You take +15% damage and are bound within 10 blocks of where you transformed
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_brief_flame.desc: Burns twice as bright, half as long.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_brief_flame.pric: The transformation lasts only half as long
glyph.isekai_mahou.tlaw_transcend.price: Drains 2% health per second; when it ends, health drops to 10%, Magic Exhaustion and Slowness/Weakness III for 60 s
spell_error.isekai_mahou.tlaw_needs_tran: %s only works after a spell that TRANSFORMS you (e.g. Self + Kaioken, Wolf Form, Transcendence).
spell_error.isekai_mahou.tlaw_too_many: Too many Transformation Laws: %s (your limit is %s; it grows with your Circle).
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.broken: The transformation ended — the vows dissolve.
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.silence_blocke: Vow of Silence: you swore not to cast while transformed.
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.fury_blocked: Blind Fury: no healing spells while the fury lasts.
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.rhythm_broken: Rhythm broken! The body pays the price.
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.oath_start: Guardian's Oath: protect the party — you can't move more than %s blocks from here.
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.oath_tether: Guardian's Oath: you can't abandon your post!
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.last_breath_en: Last Breath: the body gives in — exhausted for 30 s.
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.transcend_end: Transcend: the limit takes everything back.
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.pick_transform: You can't change vows in the middle of the Racial Transformation.
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.pick_full: Racial form law limit: %s (grows with your Circle).
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.pick_on: %s now applies to your Racial Transformation.
message.isekai_mahou.tlaw.learned_hint: Put them at the end of a spell that transforms you, or take the vow in the Grimoire: Transformation glyph → Vows tab.
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.title: Transformation Laws
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.subtitle: Vows that hold while you are transformed: always a boon and a price. Under Shape you put effects on each transformation.
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.click_on: Click to use in your Racial Transformation.
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.click_off: Click to remove from your Racial Transformation.
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.race_open: %s — unlocked (key %s). Checked laws come with it.
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.race_locked: %s — unlocks at race level V (key %s). You can already pick vows.
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.spell_help: Put the laws at the END of a spell that transforms you (e.g. Self › Kaioken › Blind Fury). Up to %s per transformation.
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.spell_known_non: none yet (Druid, Enchanter, Necromancer, Warlock, Transcendence...).
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.hollow_help: Checked laws come with your Resurrección when you release it and end with it.
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.click_on_hollow: Click to use in your Resurrección.
screen.isekai_mahou.tlaw.click_off_hollo: Click to remove from your Resurrección.
glyph.isekai_mahou.transformation.desc: You become the spell: the effects after it apply on your strikes and in your aura while it lasts. Accepts Transformation Laws at the end.
spell_error.isekai_mahou.form_no_links: The %s form does not take links (On Hit, Leap...): its effects already apply on your strikes and aura.
message.isekai_mahou.tforge.busy: You cannot swap the recipe in the middle of the transformation.
message.isekai_mahou.tforge.invalid: The recipe for %s did not apply: %s
message.isekai_mahou.tforge.no_mana: Not enough mana for the transformation recipe (needs %s): transforming without it.
message.isekai_mahou.tforge.not_forge: The recipe must start with the Transformation form.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.title: %s Transformation
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.aura_self: Aura on you every %2$s s: %1$s (%3$s power)
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.aura_allies: Aura on you and allies within %3$s blocks, every %2$s s: %1$s (%4$s power)
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.aura_foes: Enemies within %2$s blocks suffer every %3$s s: %1$s (%4$s power)
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.cost_only: Costs %s mana when you transform; lasts as long as the transformation
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.recipe_broken: This recipe is no longer valid for you (glyphs, Circle or limits changed).
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.need_form: The Transformation form comes from the Arcane path at Circle %s.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.recipe_help: Build the recipe under Shape (button at the top of the tab), or save a spell with the Transformation form in the Grimoire: it shows up here.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.recipe_count: %s saved Transformation recipe(s). With no recipe, the transformation stays as it always was.
hint.isekai_mahou.tforge_learned: Transformation form learned: build yours in the Grimoire like a Domain (form + effects + laws).
hint.isekai_mahou.tforge_cast: Transformed: your strikes apply the recipe's effects. In the Grimoire, the Transformation glyph lets you put the same effects on your race key.
hint.isekai_mahou.tforge_slot: You can shape this transformation with any effects you like: Grimoire → Transformation glyph.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.shape_subtitl: Every transformation you have takes the effects, augments and laws you want: pick one, build, save.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.list_none: no recipe — as it always was
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.btn_save_tip: Stores the recipe on this transformation. It applies from the next time you transform.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.btn_clear_tip: Removes every part. Save to put the transformation back as it always was.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.btn_book_tip: Brings in the next of your %s recipes that start with the Transformation glyph (the one open in the Grimoire first).
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.btn_book_none: You have no recipes with the Transformation form saved in the Grimoire. No need: build right here.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.body_tip: The transformation itself (look, techniques and name do not change). With the body selected, augments go on it: Extend/Shorten change the duration, Accelerate/Decelerate the cooldown, Expand gives the aura a range.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.strip_tip: Click: select (the next part goes after this one) · Right-click: remove
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.shape_empty: No recipe: this transformation stays exactly as it always was. Click the glyphs below to put whatever you want on it.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.shape_cleared: Recipe emptied. Save to remove it for good.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.pal_none: You do not know any glyphs of this kind yet.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.role_strike: On the transformation: lands on whoever you hit.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.role_aura: On the transformation: pulses on you (and on allies, with Expand on the body).
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.role_body: On the transformation: applied once, at the start.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.role_augment: Applies to the part selected on the strip.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.role_augment_: Goes on the body: duration, cooldown or aura range.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.role_law: Holds while the transformation lasts: a boon and a price.
message.isekai_mahou.tforge.only_parts: %s does not fit here: after the body only effects, augments and Transformation Laws.
hint.isekai_mahou.tforge_shape: Every transformation can be shaped with the effects and Vows you want: Grimoire → click the Transformation glyph.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.grim_subtitle: Pick one of your transformations, add effects, augments and Vows, then save.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.grim_back_tip: Back to the spell editor (Backspace works too).
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.vows_head_loo: Vows: %s of %s · ticking one applies at once, no Save needed
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.vows_head_rec: Vows: %s of %s · they go into the recipe — then click Save
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.vow_click_on_: Click: take this vow. It applies the next time you transform.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.vow_click_on: Click: put this vow in the recipe (then Save).
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.vow_click_off: Click: take this vow out of the recipe (then Save).
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.vow_click_unk: You don't know this law yet — see above where to learn it.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.btn_spell_tip: Takes these pieces to the Grimoire as a Transformation spell: save it on a key (Z/X/C/G) and cast it whenever you like.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.btn_spell_loc: To cast the Transformation as a key spell, learn the glyph (Arcane path, Circle %s). Shaping here doesn't need it.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.to_spell_done: Sent to the Grimoire: save it on a key to cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.transformation_suprem: The ULTIMATE Transformation (G key only, spends the Ultimate Charge): same as the Transformation, but it is where the supreme bodies go — The Almighty, Bankai, Vollständig, Letzt Stil, Vasto Lorde, Shadow Monarch and Transcendence. E.g.: Supreme Transformation → The Almighty → Heal. Knowing one of those bodies teaches you this form.
screen.isekai_mahou.tforge.supreme: Supreme: G key only (spends the Ultimate Charge).
message.isekai_mahou.tforge.body_in_slot: %s is a whole transformation: build it as a spell in the Grimoire (Transformation → it → effects), not in a slot.
spell_error.isekai_mahou.body_needs_tran: %s is a transformation: it only goes right after the Transformation form (e.g.: Transformation → it → effects).
spell_error.isekai_mahou.body_needs_supr: %s is a supreme transformation: use the Supreme Transformation form (G key).
